learning_objective: 🎯 Let's pick up our pens! In this chapter, we will learn how to express our heartfelt gratitude to the brave heroes protecting our nation day and night.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Imagine a soldier standing on a snowy mountain, far away from their family. A simple, hand-written letter from a young student can bring a huge smile to their face and give them emotional strength!
It is very important to tell our real-life superheroes that the entire country loves, respects, and supports them. Writing 'My Dear Soldiers' is a wonderful way to connect our hearts to the borders.
This chapter also teaches us the beautiful format of writing a friendly letter. We learn how to greet the recipient, share our honest thoughts in the body of the letter, and end with a warm closing.

fun_activity.title: ✉️ Message to a Hero!
fun_activity.instructions: Take a colorful sheet of paper and write a short, sweet letter starting with 'Dear Soldier'. Thank them for their bravery and draw a beautiful Indian flag at the bottom!

quick_recap: ⭐ Writing letters to soldiers is a beautiful way to show that the nation cares for them.
⭐ Words of appreciation boost the morale of our armed forces working in harsh conditions.
⭐ We learn how to format an informal/friendly letter to express our thoughts clearly.
⭐ A small act of kindness, like saying 'thank you', holds immense power.
